samples.question: The picture shows a plain light background crossed by thick dark walls, and five dots: one red, one green, one blue, one orange and one purple. A dot can be reached from the red dot when you can travel from the red dot to it over background only, never crossing a wall and never leaving the outer wall frame; gaps in the walls are open passages. Exactly one of the green, blue, orange and purple dots can be reached from the red dot. Which dot can be reached from the red dot? Answer green, blue, orange or purple.
